piperbrowser.title: Piper voice in the browser
piperbrowser.intro: A Piper voice made on the device, in the browser. It downloads once; after that nothing leaves the device to speak.
piperbrowser.voice.hint: A piper-voices name, like da_DK-talesyntese-medium. Empty: the voice for the device's language.
piperbrowser.speaker: Speaker
piperbrowser.speaker.hint: For a voice with more than one speaker; 0 is the first.
piperbrowser.wait.hint: Off: until the voice has downloaded, the fallback voice speaks. On: it waits, for a device with no network to fall back on.
